beats.headline: Seven inches of pink feathers, in a cage
beats.text: CAGE. Small. Pink? Pink. TWO BIG THINGS. Bite them. Bite them. Bite. Biscuits. FOOD. Peck. Peck. Cat pats head. Bite cat.

beats.headline: MOTHER comes fast
beats.text: BUG. Big bug holds Mongo. Up. Mouth. MOTHER comes fast. Bug head OFF. Mongo down. Mongo MOTHER'S now. Jump. Jump. Bite MOTHER nose.

beats.headline: Bow tie, three seconds
beats.text: BOW on neck. BAD. Off. Lady hand. Bite. MOTHER's back. Hold fur. Quiet. Quiet. Wall. WALL. Wall. MOTHER's tail. Bite.

beats.headline: Clown ankle
beats.text: Clown DOWN. Ankle. Bite. Bite. BITE. Mongo is BIGGER. Carl picks Mongo up. NO. Clown is FOOD.

beats.headline: Two more Mongos
beats.text: Mongo BIGGER. Too big for Mother's back. Collar. BAD. Mother says no. Collar stays. Two more Mongos! FRIENDS! Friends fall apart. Mongo sad. Mother, AGAIN.

beats.headline: Lion belly
beats.text: LION. Big FOOD. Belly. Rip. Rip. Lion swipes. Lion dead. Mongo on lion. RIP. Mongo BIGGER. Bigger than Mother.

beats.headline: Guarding Mother
beats.text: Mother asleep. Mother does NOT wake. Carl builds pile around Mother. Carl says STAY. Protect. Mongo on top of pile. Mongo stays.

beats.headline: He stands over her
beats.text: Mother down. Mother NOT MOVING. Mongo on top of Mother. Spiky things. MANY spiky things. Bite. Bite. Bite. Hurts. Mongo stays on Mother. Carl says something. Mongo does not listen to Carl.

beats.headline: Brown drink, then big
beats.text: Carl back. Carl pours brown drink in Mongo mouth. Spikes fall out. Mongo BIG now. Mother wakes up. MOTHER. Jump on Mother. Jump on Mother again.

beats.headline: Sparks
beats.text: Carl puts shiny teeth in Mongo mouth. Bite. SPARKS. Mongo scared. Mongo wet. Mordecai LOUD. Bite again. Sparks do not hurt Mongo. Bite. Bite. Bite. GOOD.

beats.headline: The smell in the alley
beats.text: Out of box. Street. Carl throws biscuit. GOOD. Then SMELL. Burning meat. Mongo must go. Mongo goes. Carl yells. Mother yells. Tall one. Tall one falls down. Head. Mongo has head. Shake head.

beats.headline: Benjamin, twice
beats.text: FOOD. Small lizard on a stick. BAD. Lizard comes back up. Small dwarf hits me. Arm is FOOD, and lizard again. MOTHER says HOLD. Tummy BAD. Small dwarf wants arm back. Give.

beats.headline: Pony-sized
beats.text: Cold ghosts. Bite! Level thirteen. BIG now. MOTHER on my back! Jump! Jump! MOTHER falls off. MOTHER angry.

beats.headline: Hanging ladies
beats.text: Hanging ladies. Heads FOOD. Crunch. Crunch. Crunch. One head NOT THERE. Bite legs instead. MOTHER says RETURN. Ladies wake up. Screaming. More FOOD.

beats.headline: Rabbits make everybody sick but him
beats.text: RABBIT hums. Carl falls down. MOTHER is sick. Mongo is not sick. Rabbit is FOOD. Level fourteen. Bigger now.

beats.headline: Earthquake
beats.text: Armadillo is FOOD. Crunchy. Level fifteen. Big now, big as a pony. New trick: jump, land, EARTHQUAKE. Bad things fall down. MOTHER says good boy.

beats.headline: The saddle
beats.text: MOTHER on back. Strap holds MOTHER. BAD. Mongo bucks. MOTHER flies. MOTHER lands on the potion table. Carl laughs. Katia laughs. MOTHER says BAD MONGO. Mongo rolls over. Off, saddle. OFF.

beats.headline: Down the tracks
beats.text: MOTHER on back. Down the dark tracks. Mongo RUN. Really, really fast. Dead things on tracks. MOTHER finds map. MOTHER finds gold. MOTHER says Mongo FAST.

beats.headline: Floor is FOOD
beats.text: LOCKED UP. Too long. Mongo squawks at them. Then: blood. Blood on Carl. Blood on Mother. Lick Carl. Carl smacks beak. Blood on floor. Mongo cleans floor.

beats.headline: Face first, then the hands
beats.text: Bar dog asleep. Mother says GO. Face first. Arms off at the elbow, onto the counter. NOT FOOD. Back to bar. Again. Again. Bar dog in the corner with a stick. Mother says WAIT.

beats.headline: Blood rain
beats.text: Katia goes BOOM. Red. Red EVERYWHERE. Rain! Mongo spins. Mongo splashes. Tap, tap, splash. MOTHER jumps away. Mongo stays. Mongo dances.

beats.headline: Spiky lizard eats the copies
beats.text: Two Mongos, not Mongo. Big spiky lizard. Copies BITE. Lizard CRUNCH copy. Lizard CRUNCH other copy. Mongo HOWL. MOTHER says stay back. Mongo stays. Pieces on sand. Mongo sad.

beats.headline: Too much UP
beats.text: UP. Too much UP. Brothers jump off. Basket rocks. MOTHER says carrier. NO. Carl yells very loud. Fine. Carrier.

beats.headline: Small NOT MOTHER
beats.text: Small MOTHER. Smells wrong. NOT MOTHER. Says bad things about dogs. BITE. Head off. Fire. MOTHER says bad Mongo. Too late.

beats.headline: Goose NOT FOOD
beats.text: Brothers go POP. Hurts. Goose. BITE goose. Shake goose. Goose gets up. Goose has teeth. MOTHER pulls tail. Up the stairs. Rabbit. Mine.

beats.headline: Rabbit for small gnome
beats.text: Small gnome sad. Crying smell. Rabbit from her room. Rabbit NOT FOOD. Put rabbit down. Small gnome holds rabbit.

beats.headline: The glass lady falls
beats.text: Sniff the glass lady. She WOBBLES. BAD. Back away. CRASH. Glass everywhere. Only her head stays. Carl puts the head away.

beats.headline: He finishes Maggie My
beats.text: Thing on Chris. Thing OFF Chris. Thing goes for Carl. Thing is FOOD.

beats.headline: No dinosaurs
beats.text: Mushroom points stick at Mongo. Mongo SCREECH. Mushrooms GROWL. Paper says NO DINOSAURS. Bear falls down hill. River eats bear. Carl slaps. Mongo RUN.

beats.headline: Kiwi
beats.text: Smell. Out there. Mongo RUN. MOTHER on back. Many Mongos. Big one. Pink feathers. One eye. Mongo GROWL. Big one says UNK UNK UNK. Mongo says UNK. Not fight.

beats.headline: In one side, out the other
beats.text: BIG FROG. FIRE HOLE IN FROG. MOTHER JUMPS OFF. MONGO GOES IN. MONGO EATS THROUGH. MONGO COMES OUT THE BACK. FROG GOES BOOM. MORE GUTS. FOOD.

beats.headline: Small bears, hiding
beats.text: Big one outside. Roar. Mongo SCREECH. MOTHER say shush. Small bears behind counter. Scared. Mongo peep. Small bear say Mongo not bad one. MOTHER say Mongo nice.

beats.headline: Glass of Mongo
beats.text: Sleep. Wake. Big glass of red. Smells like Mongo. NOT FOOD. BAD. Carl BAD. Next town, box on wall. Dinosaurs in box! Mongo jump. Mongo SCREECH.

beats.headline: LADIES
beats.text: MOTHER lets me out. KIWI! BITE. So many LADIES.

beats.headline: Two in the trees
beats.text: Hunters run at Carl. JUMP. Kiwi jumps too. Two for two. FOOD. MOTHER says good boy!

beats.headline: Mongo moonwalks
beats.text: SMOKE. LOUD. MOTHER on back. EARTHQUAKE. Stomp. Three lady Mongos. MOTHER says taken. Mongo DANCES. Backwards. MOTHER bops.

beats.headline: Finish her
beats.text: BUG. Mongo and Kiwi. Bite. Rip. BUG has no legs. Carl says finish. Make it hurt. Kiwi touches heads with Mongo. Kiwi goes. Mongo finishes BUG. Happy.

beats.headline: Shiny man
beats.text: SHINY MAN. OTHER MONGO IN SHINY MAN. PUSH FACE. SHINY MAN FALL DOWN. LOUD! SHINY MAN LAUGH. GOOD SHINY MAN.

beats.headline: Purple thing
beats.text: BIG LOUD CROWD. PURPLE THING! MONGO JUMP. MONGO BITE. PURPLE THING GONE. NOTHING LEFT. MONGO ANGRY.

beats.headline: On slug duty, for now
beats.text: SLUGS COME OUT OF CARL. SLUGS ARE FOOD. MOTHER SAYS EAT THE NUN. CARL SAYS WAIT. MOTHER SAYS NOT YET. SLUG DUTY. FOR NOW.

beats.headline: Hairy lady under the leaves
beats.text: Samantha SMELLS something. Leaf pile, big tree. Hairy lady asleep inside. Feet on backward. POUNCE. BITE BITE. Gone before anyone can look at her. She drops two cards.

beats.headline: The man in the sailor suit
beats.text: MOTHER ALONE. MOTHER SCARED. BAD MAN WITH CARDS. SEAL FLIPPING. MONGO JUMPS. THROAT. BAD MAN GONE. FOOD.

beats.headline: Swordfish
beats.text: FISH FLIES AT CARL. MONGO JUMPS. CATCH. GROUND SHAKES. FISH FLOP. THEN BUGS. SHINY BUGS. BAD. BAD. MONGO BACKS AWAY.

beats.headline: Turkeys
beats.text: SO MUCH FOOD. MONGO EATS HEADS. MOTHER SAYS BAD. MOTHER SAYS COME HERE. MORE FOOD. ONE TURKEY NOT FOOD. BITE. BITE. NOTHING. DARK.

beats.headline: Fake Carl
beats.text: FAKE CARL. FOOT ON CARL. BAD. MONGO HITS. FAKE CARL GONE. RED FOOD EVERYWHERE. MONGO EATS.

beats.headline: All of the hydra
beats.text: Hydra breaks. Spaghetti. FOOD. ALL FOOD. Belly hurts now. Lie down by Mother.

beats.headline: A hole under his feet
beats.text: Mongo stands by Mother. Zombie is BAD. Rip. Fish opens a hole under Mongo. Fish is BAD. Rip in half.

beats.headline: Awake, and a wing gone
beats.text: WING GONE. Burns. MOTHER rides. Running. Fire. CARL AWAKE. CARL SAYS SORRY. Push head into CARL. GOOD.

beats.headline: A potion smashed on his rump
beats.text: WING GONE. Mongo looks. Wing GONE? Mother says sit. Carl smashes glass on Mongo's butt. Sparkly. Healing. Mongo does not mind.

beats.headline: Small thing, in and out
beats.text: Small thing. Jumps IN mouth. Mother yells. Mongo swallows. Hurk. Hurk. Out again. Small thing wants back in. Mongo runs. Then: bowl. Small thing pushes bowl. SOUP. Mongo licks it all.

beats.headline: Kiwi goes inside
beats.text: Big one says PA-PA. Bear comes out. Kiwi. KIWI. Sniff. Kiwi hugs Mongo. Mongo stays still. Kiwi goes inside. Big one goes inside. Mongo sniffs air. Peep.

beats.headline: STINK, and a branch
beats.text: Skunks. STINK. Mongo in tree. Mongo sick. Sick again. MOTHER jumps onto Mongo branch. Branch goes crack. MOTHER falls. Mongo falls. Cage. Mongo whimpers.

beats.headline: Credit for the Empress
beats.text: EMPRESS is down. Mongo gets the KILL. System says so. Blue goo on the WALL. Lick the wall. MOTHER says broken home. Mongo SQUAWKS. Yes.

beats.headline: The bacon is not his
beats.text: BACON. From Katia. In the air. Mine. Second bacon, for the new one. Also mine. MOTHER says BAD. Mongo does not steal. Mongo wants third bacon.

beats.headline: Dog is BAD
beats.text: MOTHER says NO. Mongo goes down slide. Dog. Dog is BAD. Bite dog. Dog is spikes. Spikes in mouth. HURTS. Dark. Girl pours drink on Mongo. Mongo not dead.

beats.headline: Going to be a daddy
beats.text: MOTHER says Mongo DADDY. I tilt my head. MOTHER says Kiwi. MOTHER says BABY. I back up. Screech. Screech. Rend giggles.

beats.headline: Two babies
beats.text: Kiwi says MONGO. MOTHER says go. I go. Kiwi screams. A baby cries. Another baby cries. Fur. Beaks. I wave my wings. Carl pats my back.

beats.headline: NOT FOOD
beats.text: Wet plastic heart on the ground. BAD. I bite. I chew. I chew more. NOT FOOD. Spit. The System gives Mongo the kill. For the baby shower.

beats.headline: Nearly lost, and then a father
beats.text: Mongo, dinosaur, registered pet of Crawler Princess Donut, has survived the ninth floor. This was not the expected outcome. The last of Lucia Mar's dogs very nearly ate him, and Sir Rendlegore saved him, and the dog died. Mongo is also, as of the stairs, a father. Nobody is going to explain that to you, least of all me.

beats.headline: HAT
beats.text: MOTHER has a HAT. Hat is NOT FOOD. Mongo backs UP. Dong puts hat on Mongo anyway. Floppy ears. Hat is fine. Rend gets red one. Fries are FOOD.

beats.headline: Beer is FOOD
beats.text: Bug-bear man pours BEER. Slug drinks it. Mongo WANTS. MOTHER says NO. Mongo does not stay back. Now floor moves. Tater tots. FOOD. Mongo waves both wings. HAPPY.

beats.headline: Friend is dead. Friend is not dead.
beats.text: Rend not moving. Mongo stands over Rend and cries. MOTHER says time-out. Then Rend is up. Rend is BIGGER. Mongo dances. Ghoul things at door. Mongo turns too fast. Falls over.

beats.headline: He guards the garage
beats.text: Big box. Sniff. Sniff bumper. BAD. Mongo backs up. Shark on ceiling. Shark comes down. Mongo lies down by shark. MOTHER says stay. Guard Hedy. Mongo stays.

beats.headline: Into the fight
beats.text: MOTHER singing. Loud. FIGHT. Tail. People fall over. Fairy throws fire at Imani. Fairy is FOOD. MOTHER has beer on her. Lick MOTHER. MOTHER is cross.

beats.headline: Three Mongos, one sat on
beats.text: Table bites MOTHER. Now THREE Mongo. Chandelier eats shiny Mongo. BAD. Shiny Mongo goes BOOM. Mongo ANGRY. Mongo bites chairs. Big mimic last. MOTHER kills it first. Mongo sits on it anyway.

beats.headline: Claw caps
beats.text: CLAW CAPS. On FEET. Sharp. MOTHER has hats for everyone. Mongo keeps the old head thing. Mongo is marching band. Rend is marching band. Flowers on EVERYTHING. Flowers are NOT FOOD.
